title: Part 5 Practice: Wildlife Resources and Conservation in Ethiopia

questions.text: Which animal is considered Africa's rarest canid and is found only in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Correct: The Ethiopian Wolf (Semien Fox) is Africa's rarest canid. A is wrong—Walia Ibex is a goat species. C is wrong—Mountain Nyala is an antelope. D is wrong—Gelada Baboon is a primate.

questions.text: Which Ethiopian national park is predominantly a bird sanctuary known for flamingos and pelicans?
questions.explanation: Correct: Abijatta-Shalla is primarily a bird sanctuary. A is wrong—Simien has rare mammals. B is wrong—Bale has afro-alpine species. D is wrong—Omo has hippos and crocodiles.

questions.text: Which Ethiopian national park is known for the Walia Ibex and Gelada Baboon?
questions.explanation: Correct: Simien Mountains has Walia Ibex and Gelada Baboon. A is wrong—Bale has Mountain Nyala. C is wrong—Gambela has hippos and crocodiles. D is wrong—Mago has hippos and crocodiles.

questions.text: Which category of wildlife includes animals that spend most of their lives in trees and forests?
questions.explanation: Correct: Arboreals are tree-dwelling animals. A is wrong—game animals live in lowlands. C is wrong—common animals are widespread. D is wrong—rare animals are endangered.

questions.text: Which Ethiopian national parks are known for hippopotamus and crocodiles in rivers and lakes?
questions.explanation: Correct: These parks have hippos and crocodiles. A is wrong—Simien and Bale have mountain species. C is wrong—Abijatta-Shalla has birds. D is wrong—Awash and Nechsar have different species.

questions.text: The Mountain Nyala is an endemic antelope found only in which Ethiopian national park?
questions.explanation: Correct: Mountain Nyala is endemic to Bale Mountains. A is wrong—Simien has Walia Ibex. C is wrong—Awash has different species. D is wrong—Gambela has hippos and crocodiles.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a challenge facing wildlife conservation in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Correct: Strong community involvement is a solution, not a challenge. A is wrong—habitat loss is a challenge. B is wrong—poaching is a challenge. D is wrong—human-wildlife conflict is a challenge.

questions.text: Approximately how many Ethiopian Wolf individuals remain in the wild?
questions.explanation: Correct: Less than 500 Ethiopian Wolves remain. A is wrong—too low. C is wrong—too high. D is wrong—far too high.

questions.text: The Ethiopian Rift Valley lakes are globally important for:
options: B) Waterbirds including flamingos and pelicans
questions.correct_answer: B) Waterbirds including flamingos and pelicans
questions.explanation: Correct: The Rift Valley lakes are important for waterbirds. A is wrong—large mammals are in savannahs. C is wrong—afro-alpine species are in mountains. D is wrong—desert species are in lowlands.

questions.text: Which of the following is an endemic primate found only in the Bale Mountains?
questions.explanation: Correct: Bale Monkey is endemic to Bale Mountains. A is wrong—Gelada is in highlands but not only Bale. C is wrong—Grivet is widely distributed. D is wrong—Olive Baboon is widely distributed.
